_comment: Canonical intention wire format. This is the exact JSON shape that must be emitted to invoke a Brique capacity. All _note fields are documentation-only.
_intention_id_note: Required. Unique identifier for this intention. Generate a fresh UUID per call.
_await_response_note: Required. true = block until a response is received. false = fire-and-forget, no response expected.

to._comment: Required. Destination address of the capacity to invoke.
to._context_note: Required. Absolute context path from /root (e.g. '/root', '/root/workspace', '/root/workspace/child'). This is the context that owns the capacity.
to._cap_note: Required. Exact capacity name (matches cap_name in the capacity descriptor).
to._type_note: Required. Engine family that handles this capacity. Accepted values: 'communication', 'execution', 'matter', 'trace', 'reflexive', 'control', 'user'. Engine-native capacities: matter family → 'matter', reflexive family → 'reflexive', execution family → 'execution'. User-defined DSL or interpreted capacities → 'user'.
to._version_note: Optional. Leave empty in practice unless version routing is explicitly required.

from._comment: Optional in most contexts. Identifies the caller. The engine fills this automatically for internal calls.
from._cap_note: Optional. Caller capacity name. Often empty for external callers.
from._type_note: Same enum as to.type. Use 'user' for calls originating outside the engine.

identity._comment: Optional. Presence required only at trust boundaries (external callers, cross-instance calls). Typically empty inside an engine instance.

params._comment: Optional. Free-form key-value payload consumed by the targeted capacity. Shape is capacity-specific — see the capacity descriptor for the exact accepted params.

matters._comment: Optional. Matter references carried with this intention. Each entry binds a concrete matter to a logical repr name consumed by the capacity.
matters._context_note: Required per entry. Absolute context path that owns the matter.
matters._id_note: Required per entry. Matter name within its context.
matters._repr_note: Optional. Logical slot name as declared in the capacity's @matter inputs. Used by the capacity to identify which slot this matter fills.
matters._mode_note: Optional. 'read' or 'write'. Informs the engine about the intended access mode.

element_refs._comment: Optional. Non-matter element references (schema, structure, document, capacity) carried with this intention.
element_refs._id_note: Required per entry. Element name within its context.
element_refs._repr_note: Optional. Logical slot name as declared in the capacity's @schema/@structure/@document/@capacity inputs.

correlation._comment: Optional. Links this intention to a parent chain. Populated automatically by the DSL engine for sub-invocations. For top-level external calls, omit entirely.
correlation.root_intention_id: <uuid of the root intention in the chain>

_capacity_family_routing._comment: Quick reference: which to.type to use per capacity family.

_minimal_example._comment: Minimal valid intention to call matter.read in the root context.
